title: Ukulala Kwabalungile
intro: Ngesikhathi lapho ukholo lwaluyingozi futhi abanamandla befuna ukuqeda inkolelo, iqembu elincane lemiphefumulo emisha lenza ukukhetha okwakuzozwakala iminyaka eminingi. Bebaleka konke ababekwazi, bafuna isiphephelo ebumnyameni obufihliwe bentaba futhi babeka ithemba labo ngokuphelele ku-Allah. Okwenzeka ngokulandelayo kwakuyoba uphawu olungapheli kulabo abacabangayo.
clues: Sasiyiqembu labantu abasha ababekholwa eNkosini yethu, futhi yasikhulisa ngesiqondiso.
Sema phambi kwabantu bakithi samemezela ukuthi asisoze sabiza noma yimuphi unkulunkulu ngaphandle kuka-Allah.
Safuna indawo yokukhosela emhumeni, sithi, 'Nkosi yethu, siphe umusa ovela kuwe futhi usiqondise kahle endabeni yethu.'
Salala iminyaka eminingi, ilanga lalizosuka emhumeni wethu lingasithinti.
Inja yethu yayilele ilele emnyango womhume, isiqaphile sengathi iqaphile.
Lapho sivuswa, sazibuza ukuthi sesihlale isikhathi esingakanani, futhi omunye wethu wathunyelwa nezinhlamvu zesiliva ukuyothenga ukudla.
